steps.content: The red light in your palm gets brighter, illuminating Mad Shears' terrified face. It backs away with its hair-tangled shears.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: No! Stay back! Don't touch my shears!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You've all lost control! Let it go!

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: No!!
You rush forward and snatch that pair of giant, stained shears.
The red shackles tear through the contamination on the surface of the shears. The hair entangling it instantly dissolves, revealing its true appearance underneath. You're stunned...
The gigantic pair of cold and lavish shears had been halved. Only one shear remains in your hands.
You look at "Mad Shears," who is sitting on the ground like a lost soul after losing its shears. The Mania on its body has subsided, revealing a weak and cowering face.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: ...Where is this... Why am I here... Who are you... The shear you're holding is...

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Right, I'm here to find you... <color=#fb9259>Mr. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color>...
steps.female_content: Right, I'm here to find you... <color=#fb9259>Ms. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color>...

steps.content: You deny in confusion, but in that moment, your hand that's holding the shear becomes scorching hot. Your head suddenly hurts, and countless hairs coil into your vision.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...What the...
<color=#7683a2>...It’s the hair... all this cursed hair... hair that people can't get rid of on their own...</color>
Hair suddenly slithers toward you from every corner of the street, sprouting from every townsfolk. They seem to have crawled into your mind, bringing forth countless chaotic murmurs.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Murmurs
steps.content: ...I tried my best. How would I know why she's angry? Besides, why must we go to that kind of place for our date? It's suffocatingly crowded... She's getting hit on again. How dare those men look at me that way...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Murmurs
steps.content: Yeah, she'll get tired of me sooner or later... I'm not cut out to date... I can't stand it, it's unbearable... Instead of dragging things out, it's better to just break up now... It's more liberating to be single...

steps.speaker: Painful Murmurs
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>I wish I didn't do all those rotten things back then... No... If I could be as heartless as the "majority" of Syndicans, I wouldn't be suffering...</color></i >

steps.speaker: Painful Murmurs
steps.content: Ha, what a joke! Those heartless bastards are all living in style. Only a halfwit like me is suffering!

steps.speaker: Frenzied Murmurs
steps.content: What a crappy company full of morons!! Nagging me every day... What kind of crap can come out of all that nagging?! Am I here to make crap?! Am I working this hard to make crap?!!

steps.speaker: Tired Murmurs
steps.content: She's been sick for so long... My savings have bottomed out, my job is gone, and in the end, Mom is still suffering... Wonder drug... ha, a wonder drug from God knows how long ago... even the doctor has given up, why am I still holding out...

steps.speaker: Tired Murmurs
steps.content: Every day when I wake up and go to the hospital, the first thing that pops into my mind is... is she dead yet...

steps.speaker: Tired Murmurs
steps.content: I've had enough... Maybe she's better off dead? She should just die then, it'll be a relief for everyone...

steps.speaker: Ferocious Murmurs
steps.content: ...What are you smirking about? I don't want black tea! I don't want food, either!! You think these will make me happy?! I'll be happy if you're gone! I was happy before I gave birth to you! I could've had a great life! It's your fault I ended up like this!

steps.speaker: Ferocious Murmurs
steps.content: Go away, you burdensome brat! I don't want to see you!
You try to cover your ears, but your body doesn't cooperate. The surging hair approaches and entangles you. Someone walks towards you—it's the woman called "Mad Shears".
Her body changes again. Her hair grows visibly longer as she sullenly approaches you with a begging look on her face.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: I'm really worried... I've been worried for a long time... I try so hard, but I still can't catch up... I don't want to think about it anymore... but I can't break free...

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Help, I can't do it on my own. I can't get rid of it... Help me cut it off, please...
Her hair keeps growing, sprouting from every part of her body. The wriggling locks reach the ground and snake towards you as if alive.
The shear starts to heat up, and the hand that's holding it starts to move uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Help me! Cut off this hair!! Ahhh...

She pounces at you. You instinctively swing the shear to chop her thick hair. The shear lands with a thud—you fail to cut through anything, but a slimy creature is born out of it. It's a hair monster like the ones you've seen in the fog!
It turns around and pounces at the woman, who screams in terror.
But all you hear right now are the incessant whispers of the single shear in your hand.

steps.speaker: Single Shear
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>When there's only one-half of the shears, its power is halved. One chop will bring worries into reality...</color>

steps.speaker: Single Shear
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>When the shears are a complete pair, its full power is restored. One chop will sever hair and disperse all worries...</color>
The other's hair wraps around you. Strange hair sprouts from your body as you suffer a head-splitting headache.
Some sort of madness is invading your consciousness. You must fight it with all your strength. The truth of the Mad Shears of the Foggy Night is right in front of you. You must give your all...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You're the one controlling her... You use these illusions to control anyone who holds you. Whenever you slash someone, worries... no, spiritual energy... will come to life and transform into hair monsters...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You're the real Mad Shears of the Foggy Night...!
That is the truth. But what's the use of knowing it?
You want to cast aside the cold, cursed shear in your hand, yet you clutch onto this metal monster with all your strength, as if scared of letting this hard-caught culprit slip away.
The monster's voice doesn't stop, but gets louder and louder. You gradually lose control of your body.

steps.speaker: Single Shear
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>The other half of the shears... is hidden in the fog... Bring it back... You're strong enough... to bring it back...</color>

options: Don't think you can control me!

steps.content: But when you open your eyes again, you're at the top of the clock tower.
When and how did you come up here? You don't know the answer, but you can see dense hair surging from all directions, swishing and wriggling and making strange sounds.

It's not your hair, yet it wraps around your hand and drags you towards the clock dial—the frozen clock hand on it looks the same as the blade in your hand. That clock hand is precisely the other shear.
The red light in your palm becomes brighter and brighter. Your shattered memory fragments gradually reawaken.
Found you, Mad Shears! No... Sinner!
Put down your weapon! It's completely stained with Mania. You've caused way too much damage already. The MBCC will not allow this madness to continue!
This is your own voice. You suddenly remember that you're here to track down the dangerous culprit behind a series of Mania incidents.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't think you can trap me with this fog. Mad Shears of the Foggy Night, your end has come. Your identity will be exposed sooner or later. You can't escape!
Foggy night, clock chimes, inside the dark alley.
Your shackles clash violently with the blades of the shears. The shackles break, and the shears also snap into two.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh... I've been careless... They were all minor cases... I never expected that the culprit would be... an <color=#fb9259>S-Class Sinner</color>. If I had known, I should have... cough cough! !

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ha... it doesn't matter. The shears broke. It's a tie... You're also surprised. You fear the shackles...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's not over yet... I swear...

Alongside the chaotic murmurs and the townspeople's screams, your shattered memories return to you bit by bit. You want to grab them, yet you feel fear—but either way, your march towards the clock dial is unstoppable.
Let go... Let go of me...
The last bit of memory wafts back into your brain.
You try desperately to crawl out. The alley is just ahead. You hear someone walking towards you, but your memory keeps dissipating.
...It's you... I know you... I...
You see yourself reaching out to the other shear on the dial...
The moment before you touch it, someone hugs you from behind.
Enough... You already have too many worries...
You smell a familiar fragrance... a soft, gentle breath.
Or is it... Mad Shears?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Don't force yourself. This isn't something you can withstand.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Leave it to me. It's my job to begin with...
She puts her hands on your trembling hands, trying to take away the shears, but you hold on tightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This pair of shears is the source of Mania... Don't touch them. They'll control you and bombard you with illusions... You'll turn into Mad Shears...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Don't worry. They belong to me in the first place. I lost them, that's all. These are <color=#fb9259>my shears</color>.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: These aren't illusions that you see. They're real... Heavy locks of burdensome hair.
What is she saying? You have a head-splitting headache. You hear the sounds of struggle from the outside world. The fog suffocates you, and you can't see Adela clearly.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: More and more hair grew... It was my job to cut them, but I broke the shears and didn't retrieve them in time.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: A single shear can only tug and scrape hair, but it can't sever worries. The person who picked it up suffered a lot. Everyone suffered a lot. Even you saw such ghastly things.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Sorry... Thank you for finding the other shear for me. Leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have you been... deceiving me all along?
She pauses, but finally leaves the question unanswered. She just silently takes back both shear blades and gently presses them together. Click...
The moment the two shears conjoin, a powerful force floods the entire clock tower. You feel a familiar and terrifying force behind you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop, Adela, don't...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: It's time for work. When I come back, and all this is over, you'll be happy...
With a swipe of the sharp blade, Adela disappears, leaving behind only the all-consuming fog.
